int_name: RISING SUN AVE & W WYOMING AVE

result.summary: The intersection features a marked continental crosswalk and curb ramps, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and physical buffers from traffic. The environment is dominated by commercial land use with wide lanes that may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows vehicles to make right turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground corner near the gas station

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve predictability and safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Add vegetation or a furniture zone to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks and signalization. However, safety is compromised by faded markings, poor pavement quality, and sightline obstructions from parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra stripes are significantly worn, reducing visibility to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt in the roadway and near the crossing area.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars and vans near the corner may block sight lines between pedestrians and turning motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the curb.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Refresh crosswalk markings with high-visibility thermoplastic material to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to reduce crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection in a commercial area with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals. However, the environment is dominated by wide travel lanes and lacks physical buffers or traffic calming measures, leading to significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide curb radii
hazards.description: The corner design allows vehicles to make right turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians at the crossing.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Lack of physical buffers
hazards.description: There is no vertical separation like trees or bollards between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade existing markings to continental or ladder patterns to improve visibility to drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with high-visibility crosswalk markings and overhead traffic signals. While sidewalks are present, the environment lacks pedestrian-specific protections like refuge islands or curb extensions, resulting in a relatively long and exposed crossing distance.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sight lines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.
